name: Ethan Miller
bio:
Ethan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering on his grandfather's classic car. This early exposure ignited a passion for mechanics and engineering that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he worked at a local race shop, honing his skills in fabrication and welding. His dedication and precision quickly caught the eye of larger teams, eventually landing him a role at Williams Racing.

Ethan approaches his role as a fabricator with meticulous attention to detail. He's known for his ability to translate complex engineering drawings into tangible, high-quality components. Ethan thrives under pressure, consistently delivering exceptional work even when faced with tight deadlines. He is a firm believer in continuous improvement, always seeking new techniques and materials to enhance performance and reliability. What sets Ethan apart is his ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and his unwavering commitment to quality.
